stories.title: A nation trapped: photographing the broken promises of Sudan's revolution
stories.summary: Syrian-born photographer Abdulmonam Eassa travelled to Sudan as the fall of its longtime dictator, toppled by massive protests, raised hopes of a democratic rebirth. Instead, he witnessed the country descend into another military takeover, rivalry and all-out war. RFI spoke to him about the resulting photo series, War in Sudan: A Nation Trapped, which is now on show at the Visa pour l'Image festival in southern France.

stories.title: Coach Luis Enrique unconcerned by PSG’s poor start to French league season
stories.summary: Two points from three matches is their worst start since the 2007-08 season, when PSG came close to relegation. Paris Saint-Germain have not had as poor a start to a league season for 19 years, with Friday’s home loss to Monaco leaving them winless after three matches in the Ligue 1 season. Days before they begin the defence of their Champions League title, however, the Parisians have handed coach Luis Enrique a contract extension until 2030. “There is no reason to be concerned. I say that honestly. How many shots on target did Monaco have? How many goals? We’ll see at the end of the season whether things balance out,” he said after Friday’s 2-1 setback in which they were ahead at halftime but conceded twice after the break. “What I want to get across is that you shouldn’t look only at the result,” Luis Enrique added. “We pressed sensationally, much better than in many matches when we did not concede a goal. But luck was not on our side. “Monaco know that if they play against us like this 10 times, we win eight, there’d be one draw and we’d lose once.

stories.title: Odessa port nearly lifeless following Russian strikes — resistance member
stories.summary: Russian strikes targeted only dry cargo ships "used to transport dual-use goods, as well as fuel storage tanks intended for military purposes."
article_sentences: The port of Odessa now looks almost deserted following Russian strikes over the summer, a member of the region’s pro-Russian underground resistance said.
"The Odessa port now looks almost deserted compared with what it was like in June.
After the latest Russian strikes, the berths are no longer operational as major shipping companies have left," he said.
The resistance member stressed that Russian strikes targeted only dry cargo ships "used to transport dual-use goods, as well as fuel storage tanks intended for military purposes."
TASS reported earlier, citing Russian Defense Ministry data, that Russian forces had hit more than 150 seagoing vessels and patrol boats at Ukrainian ports and in the Black Sea over the summer.

stories.title: Watch: Drop Shot EP 10 | Chennai’s bookstores, Kaber Vasuki, Hyderabad bagels and a 50-year-old croc bank
stories.summary: In Episode 10, we explore four stories that capture the changing cultural landscape of Chennai and beyond. From North Chennai’s neighbourhood bookstores that continue to nurture reading communities, to indie musician Kaber Vasuki and his distinctive musical journey, we meet people and spaces shaping contemporary culture. We also travel to Hyderabad, where a homegrown bagel brand is heading to New York’s Bagel Fest, and look at the Madras Crocodile Bank as it marks 50 years of conservation, education and reptile care.
